svg.title: FakeIP: DNS to domain-based proxy routing
svg.desc: A 16.25-second loop with two domain requests. DNS queries pass through dnsmasq to sing-box, which stores and returns a fake IP. Linux routing sends TCP traffic into sing-box TUN. sing-box recovers the domain from the mapping and forwards it to V2RayN. Domain rules select proxy for blocked.site and direct for google.com. Orange marks the Kali VM; blue marks the physical Windows host.

g.aria-label: Orange: Kali VM, virtual. Blue: Windows host, physical.
